distortion_assumption: CARLA sensor.camera.rgb pinhole camera; no lens distortion model configured
notes: High precision projection validation in CARLA Town05 used three red vehicle targets at 12m/-3.5m, 20m/0m and 30m/3.5m relative to ego. The exact-frame RGB image was compared against the projected 3D bounding boxes using tight target ROIs; center errors were 4.63, 1.51 and 1.06 px, with a maximum of 4.63 px under a 5 px acceptance threshold. This validates the CARLA virtual camera projection, not a physical camera calibration.
